class.name: DDGIProbeData
class.description: The irradiance and distance of every probe of a [DDGIVolume], their offsets and states, and the volume they were baked for (cascades, probe grid, probe spacing and center). Made by [method DDGIVolume.bake]; see [member DDGIVolume.bake_mode] for how it is used. The data is only used while it fits the volume: moving or resizing the volume, or changing its probe spacing or cascades, needs a new bake. The atlas resolution comes from the DDGI quality setting at bake time.

method.name: get_cascades
method.description: Returns the number of cascades the data was baked with.

method.name: get_center
method.description: Returns the center of the volume the data was baked for, in world space.

method.name: get_data
method.description: Returns the baked data, as returned by [method RenderingServer.viewport_get_ddgi_probe_data].

method.name: get_probe_grid
method.description: Returns the number of probes per axis of each cascade.

method.name: get_probe_spacing
method.description: Returns the probe spacing of the finest cascade, in meters.

method.name: set_data
method.description: Sets the baked data, in the format of [method RenderingServer.viewport_get_ddgi_probe_data].
